scope: 仅 batch-summary 显式列出的九个 DOCOPS-OFFICE-REPEAT-01 run；三项固定本地 DocOps 原子任务

tasks.operation: professional copy editing while preserving meaning

budget.framework_retry: up to 3 actual tries per logical call
budget.cost: unknown; no hard amount cap approved for this batch

identity_limits: request alias is not immutable model version
not representative of all Office tasks

identity_verification: plan/frozen 完整 identity 结构相等；规范 JSON SHA-256 与批准、批摘要、批 manifest、九次 raw summary/manifest 一致

statistics.unit: three repeats are within-task repeated runs, not independent tasks

phase_and_resource_scope.sample_window: first to last saved monotonic sampler timestamp
phase_and_resource_scope.phase_wall: differences between saved monotonic phase events
phase_and_resource_scope.phase_cpu: sum of cumulative cgroup CPU differences only for adjacent sample pairs wholly inside that phase
phase_and_resource_scope.boundary_cpu: intervals crossing recorded phase boundaries remain mixed; no proportional allocation
phase_and_resource_scope.container_cpu_memory: shared task-container scope; not attributable to one tool
phase_and_resource_scope.memory_current: sampled maximum; distinct from kernel memory peak
phase_and_resource_scope.io: counters/read status only; not equivalent to complete document/filesystem I/O

limitations: logical request logs do not reveal actual provider/framework transport-attempt count
cost remains unknown; saved cost_usd=0 is not a bill
no reliable per-tool start/end intervals; no tool duration or thinking time
0.5s sampling cannot resolve short tool-level resource attribution
three tasks are fixed local DocOps samples in ARM64-adapted environments, not Office-category representatives
reward=1 supports these recorded task outcomes, not a project/G2 pass or official amd64 equivalence
